Article 5.2: Payout Eligibility by Account Type

Warren's summary

Only profit earned since your last payout can be withdrawn, or since the account was funded for your first payout. OG Funded Accounts require account balance above the Minimum Threshold, consistency at 40% or below, withdrawal of at least $500, and cumulative withdrawals across all accounts not exceeding $10,000. Standard MAX Funded requires a fully built buffer, account balance $500+ above buffer, consistency at 40% or below, withdrawal of at least $500, per-account cap compliance, and cumulative withdrawals not exceeding $10,000. Express MAX Funded requires a fully built buffer, account balance $500+ above buffer, consistency at 25% or below, 5 winning days accumulated since last withdrawal, withdrawal of at least $500, per-account cap compliance, and cumulative withdrawals not exceeding $10,000, with the winning-day counter resetting after each withdrawal.

Only profit earned since your last payout can be withdrawn. For your first payout, that is the profit earned since the account was funded. This applies to every Sim Funded account.

OG Funded Accounts: Withdrawal Checklist
Account balance is above the Minimum Threshold
Consistency is 40% or below
Withdrawal amount is at least $500
Cumulative withdrawal (all accounts) does not exceed $10,000
Standard MAX Funded: Withdrawal Checklist
Buffer is fully built
Account balance is $500+ above buffer
Consistency is 40% or below
Withdrawal amount is at least $500
Withdrawal amount does not exceed per-account cap
Cumulative (all accounts) does not exceed $10,000
Express MAX Funded: Withdrawal Checklist
Buffer is fully built
Account balance is $500+ above buffer
Consistency is 25% or below
5 winning days accumulated since last withdrawal (or since funded)
Withdrawal amount is at least $500
Withdrawal amount does not exceed per-account cap
Cumulative (all accounts) does not exceed $10,000
WINNING DAYS RESET AFTER EACH PAYOUT: EXPRESS MAX FUNDED After each withdrawal, the 5-winning-day counter resets. You must accumulate 5 new winning days before your next payout. Consistency also resets per account after withdrawal. However, your best-day P&L record does NOT reset.
